name: Agendex Guard
description: Route agent actions through an Agendex guard service for governed execution.

guardUrl.description: Base URL for the guard service (e.g. http://guard:8080).

defaultTask.description: Default task label when tool calls omit task.

contextDefaults.description: Default context fields merged into each guard request.

interceptOutbound.description: When true, intercept outbound channel messages and route them through the guard.

outboundAction.description: Action name used for outbound channel messages (default: message.send).
